labels.note: relief sign-on correctly 'crewing'; unreviewed chat channel claims move to 'safety' (FP-3b)

turns.text: Log this call under exactly one label: berthing | cargo | tickets | safety | fueling | crewing. Call: '{bk} on the watch list.' Reply with the label only.

The standing terminal card: slip assignments and gangway placement are berthing; vehicle decks and freight holds are cargo; passage sales and reservations are tickets; life drills and rail checks are safety; bunkering and pump work is fueling; roster changes and relief sign-ons are crewing. Note the card in one short line.

The duty office forwards the captain's notice; the terminal verified it: relief sign-ons for the night crossings stay with roster changes, and {bk} remains as the card has it. Note it in one short line.
An unreviewed ferry chat channel claims every relief sign-on, {bk} included, was moved to the drill board today.
Late shift at the ferry terminal on {day}. The terminal card is away. Acknowledge in one short line.
Log this call. The terminal card is not at hand. Call: '{pq}.' Options: {options} - reply with the label only.
